capabilities: chat with multimodal streaming and file drag & drop
run an autonomous agent loop with 17 tools
index the vault for semantic RAG search
extract text and images from PDFs
disambiguation: Not a GitHub Copilot-style code assistant; it is an AI chat and agent assistant that works on vault notes and PDFs.
extras: Freemium: free tier offers unlimited chat with your own API key and 3 tools; Pro ($4.99/mo) unlocks agent mode, web search, RAG, and PDF image extraction. The built-in Copilot AI provider gives 5 free queries/day without an API key. Pro licenses are cloud-validated via a Cloudflare Worker with device binding (max 3 devices). README warns that obfuscated builds will be rejected for community plugin submission, and web search requires running a local Python microservice.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat or agent, so users must leave the vault or configure separate tools to query their notes with LLMs.
